## Checklist

<!-- Check only completed items. For a non-applicable item, leave it unchecked and explain why beside it. A checklist does not replace CI or review. -->

- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/richardrh/dartaframes/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and kept the change focused.
- [ ] Dart formatting and `dart analyze --fatal-infos` pass with the repository lint rules.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated, or the validation section explains why none are needed.
- [ ] Test results and any skipped checks are recorded above.
- [ ] Public API doc comments, examples and site documentation are updated where affected.
- [ ] Breaking changes and native ownership/lifetime implications are documented above.
- [ ] The changelog is updated for user-visible changes, or an exemption is explained.
- [ ] Dependency, protocol or packaging changes pass the relevant release/publish checks, or are marked not applicable.
